sn45.48:1.2: vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam puccheyyuṃ || ||
sn45.48:1.3: Kim atthi yam āvuso samaṇe Gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatī ti || evam puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesam añña- pari- evam vyākareyyātha || ||
sn45.48:1.4: Anupādāparinibbānatthaṃ kho avuso Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī ti || || 3.
sn45.48:1.5: Sace pana vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam puccheyyuṃ || ||
sn45.48:1.6: Atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā anupādāparinibbānāyā ti || evam puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesaṃ añña- parib- evaṃ vyākareyyātha || ||
sn45.48:1.7: Atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā anupādāparinibbānāyā ti || || 4.
sn45.48:1.8: Katamo ca bhikkhave maggo katamā ca paṭipadā anupādāparinibbānāya || ||
sn45.48:1.9: Ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo || seyyathīdaṃ || ||
